answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded identity crystal that cannot be split: each agent mints one registration credential whose secret is bound to a paid, non-transferable bond, and the registry records it as a single unforgeable edge. Every epoch, agents wander through a rotating attestation round where each credential signs a fresh challenge with its bond locked, so copies of one secret collide and get slashed. An operator growing an orchard of fakes must fund a separate bond per tree, while a forgery reusing one secret exposes the whole orchard to one slash.
